name: Fast Leaf Fall
summary: Chop down a tree and watch its crown fall apart in moments, dropping saplings and apples right where you stand.
logoPrompt: A single green oak leaf drifting down at a slight angle, with a few small falling leaf particles around it, centred, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: Fell a tree, the leaves follow fast.

description: **Fast Leaf Fall clears the leaves of a felled tree within a few seconds, so you no longer wait minutes for saplings or leave floating crowns behind.**
- Once the last log of a tree is gone, its leaves decay one after another within about three seconds.
- The drops are the usual ones: saplings, sticks and apples.
- Only leaves the game would let decay anyway are sped up; leaves you placed yourself stay forever.
- Leaves still close enough to another trunk stay, so neighbouring trees keep their crowns.
- Works however the logs disappear: axe, fire or explosion.
Put the jar into the `mods` folder next to Fabric API. Chop a tree as usual and collect the saplings.
- Made for Fabric Loader on Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.1 and needs Fabric API.
- Works in singleplayer and on servers. On a server only the server needs it; players can join without installing anything.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
